title: Note Tax Refunds on Merchandise Purchases — Finch Circle Member Spend Goodwill
content:
On a refund of sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid on a Merchandise Purchases unit, a member whose Finch Circle qualifying spend posted in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchase earn entries whose posting date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reaches the upper tax member spend threshold of $2000.00 receives the upper tax member spend goodwill of $1.00; one whose such spend reaches the middle tax member spend threshold of $1000.00 but not the upper receives the middle tax member spend goodwill of $0.50.

## Points of judgement

- *Source of the spend:* the qualifying amount of the purchase earn entries in the member's Finch Circle Loyalty Program points ledger, posted less than twelve whole months before the request date.
- *Spend of exactly $2000.00:* $1.00. *Of $1999.99:* $0.50.
- *Spend of exactly $1000.00:* $0.50. *Of $999.99:* neither threshold is reached, and the customer is outside this rule.
